settings.title: Settings
settings.cat.generalSub: How the window behaves and how the tribe list is arranged.
settings.cat.jobsSub: Which job runs each kind of tribe.
settings.cat.afterRunSub: Chat commands to fire once every queued tribe has finished.
settings.languageHelp: Language for this plugin's interface. Tribe names always follow your game client.
settings.openOnLogin: Open on login when dailies are available
settings.openOnLoginHelp: Shows this window after logging in whenever you still have daily allowances to spend.
settings.expansionOrderHelp: Which end of the expansion picker the newest content sits on.
settings.order.newestDetail: Dawntrail leads the expansion picker, A Realm Reborn closes it.
settings.order.oldestDetail: A Realm Reborn leads the expansion picker, Dawntrail closes it.
settings.jobSpecificHelp: The gearset for this job is equipped before the tribe's dailies are accepted.
settings.job.currentDetail: Keeps whatever job of this type you are wearing when the run starts.
settings.job.highestDetail: Switches to the gearset of your highest-level job of this type.
settings.job.lowestDetail: Switches to the gearset of your lowest-level job of this type, handy for levelling.
settings.job.specificDetail: Always switches to the job picked below.
settings.crafter.title: Crafter tribes
settings.crafter.help: Which Disciple of the Hand job runs crafter tribe dailies.
settings.crafter.scope: Ixal · Moogles · Dwarves · Loporrits · Yok Huy
settings.crafter.footnote: This choice only picks the job that accepts and turns in the dailies. Ixal dailies also contain combat, gathering and fishing steps that Questionable runs on its own: combat on its Preferred Combat Job (your highest-level job unless you change it in Questionable's settings), gathering on Miner or Botanist, fishing on Fisher through AutoHook.
settings.gatherer.title: Gatherer tribes
settings.gatherer.help: Which Disciple of the Land job runs gatherer tribe dailies.
settings.gatherer.footnote: Fisher is excluded. Questionable cannot automate fishing, so gatherer tribes run on Miner or Botanist and any fishing daily is skipped.
settings.combat.title: Combat tribes
settings.combat.help: Which combat job runs battle tribe dailies.
settings.combat.scope: Amalj'aa · Sylphs · Kobolds · Sahagin · Vanu Vanu · Vath · Kojin · Ananta · Pixies · Arkasodara · Pelupelu
settings.combat.footnote: Applies to combat tribes only. Combat steps inside Ixal dailies use Questionable's Preferred Combat Job, not this choice.
settings.postRun.label: Run when the batch finishes
settings.postRun.help: One command per line, each starting with a slash. They fire only when every queued tribe has finished on its own, never after Stop.
settings.postRun.caption: Lines that do not start with a slash are skipped, so nothing is ever said in chat. Try /li home to head home or /ays m to hand off to AutoRetainer.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.allInstalled: All required plugins are installed and loaded.
plugins.footer: Install adds the plugin's repository to Dalamud and queues an install. If one-click install fails, click a plugin name to open its repository or right-click to copy the URL, then add it under /xlsettings, Experimental, Custom Plugin Repositories.
plugins.textAdvanceDisabled: Loaded, but TextAdvance's own "Enable plugin" toggle is off. Questionable needs it on to advance quest dialogue and cutscenes; with it off, dailies stall mid-quest. Turn it on in TextAdvance's settings.

plugins.purpose.questionable: Plays out each daily quest after the plugin accepts it.
plugins.purpose.textAdvance: Auto-advances quest dialogue and cutscenes so Questionable can complete each daily.
plugins.purpose.artisan: Crafter tribes. Questionable crafts every crafter daily through it, so those tribes are skipped without it.
plugins.purpose.autoHook: Ixal fishing dailies. Questionable fishes through it; without it those three dailies are skipped.
log.title: Run log
log.empty: Nothing logged yet. Start a run and every step the plugin takes shows up here.
log.footer: The same lines go to the Dalamud log (/xllog) with the [ADT] prefix. When reporting a bug, copy this log and paste it into the issue.
about.supportBody: I build and maintain this in my spare time. If it has helped you, a Patreon membership lets me keep improving it. No pressure, and thank you for being here.
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.fact.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.fact.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.fact.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.fact.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.fact.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.fact.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.fact.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.fact.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.fact.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.fact.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.fact.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quote.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quote.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quote.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quote.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quote.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quote.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quote.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quote.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.joke.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.joke.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.joke.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.joke.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.joke.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.joke.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.joke.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.joke.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.joke.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.joke.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
